collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Name, email address, profile photo (from Google if you use Google sign-in), classroom memberships, messages you send, and verification documents (auto-deleted after 30 days). If you connect LinkedIn: your LinkedIn name and profile photo only — LinkedIn's standard sign-in does not give us your job title, employer, location, or education history, so we never collect or store those.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: To connect you with your alumni network and verify your membership in classrooms. We never use your data for advertising.

never.title: What we never do
never.body: We never sell your data or show ads. We use the following trusted services to operate AlumTribe: Supabase (database and authentication), Render (application hosting), Cloudflare (content delivery and DNS), Resend (transactional emails), Google (sign-in, if you use Google login), LinkedIn (profile sync, only if you connect LinkedIn). Each provider has their own privacy policy. We do not sell your data to any of these providers.

protect.title: How we protect it
protect.body: All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Row-level security means you only see data you are permitted to see. We use Cloudflare to protect against DDoS attacks and malicious traffic — Cloudflare may log your IP address. Verification documents are automatically deleted after 30 days.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can request a copy of your data or correct it at any time. To delete your account: email hello@alumtribe.com to request account deletion. We will delete your data within 30 days. (Self-service account deletion is not yet built in the app — this email process is the interim way to do it.)

retention.title: Data retention
retention.body: Messages: kept until you delete them or your account. Verification documents: automatically deleted after 30 days. OTP codes: automatically deleted after use or expiry. Account data: kept until you request deletion.

what.title: What AlumTribe is
what.body: A private verified network for school and college alumni.

who.title: Who can use it
who.body: You must be a genuine alumni, student, or teacher of the institution you are joining. Fake accounts or joining classrooms you were not part of is not allowed.

verification.title: Verification
verification.body: We require verification before you can post. Providing false verification documents is grounds for permanent removal.

conduct.title: Conduct
conduct.body: No spam, harassment, hate speech, or illegal content. Keep conversations respectful. Admins can remove content and suspend accounts that violate these rules.

ourRights.title: Our rights
ourRights.body: We can remove content or suspend accounts that violate these terms. We will always try to notify you first.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: AlumTribe is provided as-is. We are not liable for content posted by users.
